description: Hi! We are entering the NASA competition to build creative and interactive project experiences. We love space, technology, storytelling, and working on fun ideas together. Looking for friendly team members interested in coding, design, research, or storytelling to join us! Everyone is welcome to collaborate with us.
summary: We built an Interactive Earth Model. Inside a small jar, we created a mini ecosystem with dough. The lid is painted as Planet Earth. We placed a speaker outside to play nature sounds, making the experience interactive.
details:
> For our NASA Space Apps Challenge project, *we made an interactive Earth model.*

> We used dough inside a small jar to build a mini ecosystem, with a green apple tree and a river.

> We painted the lid like Planet Earth.

> And we placed a speaker outside the model. When you look at our Earth model, you can also listen to nature and Earth sounds in a fun and creative way.

> Our goal is to help people feel connected to our Planet
